fala: When it was $140, you didn't buy it. I get it. When it dropped to $120, you still didn't buy it. I get that too.
But at this price, I honestly should have waited because I paid full price for mine.
This CC sportless wheel trimmer works as a mower, trimmer, and edger in one.
It weighs about 10 pounds and the support wheels carry most of the weight, so you're basically just guiding it through the yard.
You can adjust the cutting angle for fences, sidewalks, and tight spaces, and also control the cutting height.
It uses a heavy-duty metal blade for thicker grass and weeds.
It comes with two 21-volt batteries for longer run time, so you're not constantly stopping to be charged.
No gas, no cords, no pull start. Just install the battery and go.
CC has sold over one million products.
Grab yours before they sell out.
